patch: Proposed registry additions used by Example 2 (access-policy audit)

Families.doc: indexed families elaborated before checking: a Map with (Parameters ($p Carrier) ...) is a family of unary maps, applied as (f p1 ... x); (For $v Carrier) on an Observe or Action entry declares one entry per element, labelled by the instantiated label term, in the order of the For clauses and of each carrier's enumeration; (Switch $p (element expr)+) selects on a parameter and must be total and exclusive over its carrier; (Exists $v C e) and (ForAll $v C e) range over an enumerated carrier; Any in a Successor entry stands for every action label

Parameters.doc: elaboration-time parameters, each ($p Carrier) over an enumerated carrier

ActionsOf.doc: the action entries of another machine on a carrier of the same element type

Like.doc: the observe and action entries of another machine; States may differ (a scope)

Invariant.doc: a candidate inductive invariant for a reachability scope: checked to contain the initial states and to be closed under every action, then used to discharge the universal obligations

notes.Unrollings: bounded search depth for reachable counterexamples when an inductive argument fails; a work limit, never a semantic horizon
notes.Gather: (Gather x i1 ... ik) is the k-bit word whose bit j is bit i_j of x
